meta.title: Gaps and Opportunities
meta.the_question: Can this group reach the gospel today — in their heart language, or through a bridge language of their country that already carries a resource?
meta.opportunity_meaning: No resource in the heart language, but a language spoken by MULTIPLE groups in the same country DOES have one. Reachable now with what already exists.
meta.aligned_meaning: ALIGNED = an opportunity where the ENVIRONMENT also lines up: a bridge resource exists AND the country has internet (yes/partial) AND there is a known channel people are already on. Brief: "opportunities exist in many places where resources and environment are all aligned for the gospel work to happen." These are the highest-leverage rows here.
meta.gap_meaning: Nothing found in the heart language AND no in-country bridge language carries anything, in the pools checked.
meta.bridge_strength_note: MEASURED: 24% of aligned rows rest on a bridge shared by only 2-3 groups. bridge_strength grades this (strong >=8 groups, moderate >=4, weak <4). A WEAK bridge is a hypothesis, not a route — e.g. "Gawri" was offered as the bridge for 10.3M Pakistanis where the real lingua franca is Urdu, which no unengaged group here claims as primary and which this method therefore cannot see. Filter on bridge_strength before acting.
meta.bridge_caveat: A bridge candidate is measured from THIS corpus (a language primary to >1 DX group in the country). It is NOT proof the group speaks it, and it is NOT a national trade language — a lingua franca no unengaged group claims as primary is invisible here.
meta.pools_caveat: Resource status is from eBible + JESUS Film. GRN and FCBH audio are key-blocked and unchecked — absence is never proof.
